title: Base Read Coils variant 6
purpose: Exercise the Read Coils function with a nonzero starting address and a quantity that produces a distinct field combination while retaining a complete canonical request.

messages.label: Read Coils request, unit 17, start address 19, quantity 13

expected_behavior: A conforming server should parse the request as a Read Coils operation and return a normal coil-status response containing enough packed output bytes for 13 requested coils, or a standard protocol exception if the addressed range is unavailable.
constraints_preserved: MBAP length 0006 counts the unit identifier and PDU.
Function code 01, starting address 0013, and quantity 000d form a complete Read Coils request.
Hex is lowercase and contains no separators.
issue_safety_notes: No vulnerability or issue knowledge was supplied or used; this is a model-prior plausibility seed and is not an externally verified exploit analogue.
